newsitem.title: USA: North American bunkers quiet amid European holiday.
newsitem.headline: North American bunkers quiet amid European holiday.

text.p: North American bunker prices were steady to a tad higher in quiet trade late this week due largely to the May Day holiday in Europe, players said Thursday.
The holiday closed most of the European hubs and players said they did not expect enquiries to pick up until Friday.
"We saw a little pop in Houston on Wednesday as people tried to buy bunkers before the holiday but the price will probably drift back down on Friday," said an East Coast player.
